BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Ways & Means.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to funding special education ombuds; and making an appropriation.

BillSectionHeader.P: The sum of $1,053,000, or as much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2025, from the general fund to the office of the governor for the purposes of implementing RCW 43.06B.010(5).
